site.domainNote: AI voice role-play language learning (Gemini Live API demo) — mission briefing screen before a spoken conversation

view.name: Roleplay chat session
view.description: Live voice roleplay with a Spanish barista persona, showing mission header, language pair, tips pill and a scrolling transcript with teacher-mode English coaching.

regions.label: Minimal top bar: circular back arrow, dashed-outline GitHub 'Source' link, emoji theme toggle
Scenario title 'Flustered/Panicked Barista', English→Spanish language pill, mission 'Order a Coffee' with description, hint pill about translations & explanations
Between two hairline rules: auto-animating karaoke-style sample transcript of the AI barista speaking Spanish with English coaching, fading at top; canvas lines (likely audio visualizers)
Large olive-green 'Start Mission — You start the conversation!' button with glow shadow

patterns.rationale: Capture is the pre-start screen; the voice conversation with the AI character starts only after 'Start Mission' (mic access), so the conversation UI itself is not observed. The transcript area shows an animated sample of an AI reply with spoken-word highlighting.

evidence.quote: ¡Ay, buenos días! Perdona, perdona, la máquina está haciendo un ruido rarísimo…
evidence.note: Sample AI character turn revealed word-by-word like streaming speech transcript
Starts the voice conversation; 'You start the conversation!'

patterns.rationale: The pill is an always-visible hint telling the learner they can ask the AI for help mid-conversation; it advertises help rather than being help itself.

evidence.quote: You can ask for translations & explanations at any time.

evidence.note: Language-pair pill is a standalone metadata label, not an indicator on another element
Only back button and utility links; no global navigation
No composer visible; only a start button

structure.layout: single centered narrow column (~472px) with minimal top bar (back arrow left, Source link + theme toggle right); title, language-pair pill, mission brief, hint pill, animated transcript preview between hairline rules, big primary CTA

aesthetics.typography: Libre Baskerville bold serif for the scenario title only; Nunito (rounded sans) for everything else — mission title, body, transcript, pills, buttons
aesthetics.typeScale: Restrained: 24px/700 serif title, 21px bold button label, 19-18px mission heading and transcript body, 16px description, 14px pills and italic button subtitle; contrast mostly from serif vs sans and weight

notes: Warm cream paper background with olive-green (#5c6b48) brand used for bold keywords, pill outlines, the dashed 2px Source button border and the large glowing CTA. Transcript preview animates word-by-word like karaoke, older lines fade to light grey at top, new words fade in. CTA has a soft pulsing halo. Flag emojis in language pill; emoji 💻 theme toggle. Canvas elements sit at the hairline rules (likely audio waveform visualizers during the session).
